files.title: NISR SAS district crop area and production, 2023–2026
files.publisher: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
files.reference_period: 2023 Seasons A/B/C; 2024 Seasons A/B/C; 2025 Seasons A/B/C; 2026 Seasons A/B
files.units: cultivated area in hectares (ha); production in tonnes (MT)
files.processing_steps: Long-format aggregate of matched district/crop/season cultivated area and production tables. See source fields on every row and source_workbooks for workbook hashes and table numbers.
files.limitations: NISR source data; structural validation is performed by CropPulse but does not independently verify NISR's survey estimates. 2026 covers Seasons A and B only. Missing/dash cells and explicit 0/0 non-cultivation pairs are not emitted. Area/production pairs with zero area and positive production are excluded and enumerated in quality_report. This dataset does not support image diagnosis or disease-treatment recommendations.

source_workbooks.title: NISR Seasonal Agricultural Survey 2023 Season A tables
source_workbooks.publisher: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
source_workbooks.units: cultivated area in hectares (ha); production in tonnes (MT)
source_workbooks.processing_steps: Read district-level cultivated-area Table 10 and crop-production Table 22; matched district and selected crop columns; omitted dash/blank/NA cells and explicit 0/0 non-cultivation rows; retained positive-area records with zero production.
source_workbooks.limitations: Aggregate district-season observations. Not farmer-level data, disease prevalence, causal analysis, or a crop recommendation by itself. CropPulse supports only the selected crop categories listed in the import code.
